claims.summary: For every N>=3 and every collision pattern (a proposed class, defined so far for multiplicities at most two), the degree-two pair space of a generic configuration of that pattern has only simple finite non-branch Weierstrass points; in a cluster degeneration these points distribute over the main (binary-face) component, a chain of neck components at rational scales eps^(-k/3)-type, and the bubble (a one-double-root space), each point simple on its component.
claims.assessment: Conjecture; supported by the proved binary-face theorem, the exact seven-root confluent certificate (all non-branch weights one), and an exact multiscale computation at five roots (3 main + 6 + 6 neck + 15 bubble, all simple, neck points in approximately hexagonal clusters at scales consistent with 1/3 and 2/3).
claims.rationale: Codimension-one analogue of the statements a boundary induction would need to prove the Weierstrass-weight bounds behind open statement 3 in every dimension.
claims.next_action: Identify the neck limit spaces via the Newton polygon of the Wronskian numerator in (eps,T) and determine their Weierstrass points from the edge polynomials.

claims.summary: At five roots (eps*(1,2,-3), 1, -1) with eps=1e-3,1e-5,1e-10, the exact Wronskian numerator has 30 simple non-branch roots: 3 at scale 1 (near the zeros of Q_3), 6 at |T|~eps^(-0.347) with arguments (k+1/2)pi/3 to printed precision, 6 at |T|~eps^(-2/3) with arguments near k*pi/3, and 15 at scale 1/eps; the main and bubble limits miss 12 of 30 points (40 of 210 at seven roots).
claims.assessment: Finite check: exact rational numerator, roots at 400-digit precision, three values of eps; scale exponents are read numerically and extrapolated, not proved.
claims.rationale: Shows the neck obstacle to transferring component simplicity and its rational multiscale structure.

relationships: The main component of the cluster degeneration.
